name: willow
description: Voice-first journaling PWA — ramble at the end of the day; Willow transcribes, cleans, and stores it as a journal entry.
author: Sudip Ghosh <sudipghosh9333@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build -w @willow/shared && npm run build -w @willow/web && npm run build -w @willow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @willow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @willow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @willow/api && npm run typecheck -w @willow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @willow/shared && npm run test -w @willow/api
